The '''Dark Jedi Hideout''' was a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] enclave on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Located in the [[Swamp of Fallen Stars]], the hideout was home to a number of Dark Jedi, the leader of which was known as [[Magus Jocle]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] tasked a group of loyal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Jocle, after it was revealed that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] responsible for destroying the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="SWG:DVI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Jedi Hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DVI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Dark Jedi Hideout was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]]," released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
